title: Supervision page for all roles
agent_directive: This JSON is the complete task spec. First read docs/prompts/_standards.json once, then load the skills in `skills`. Read only the `spec_sections` of docs/fypms-docs.md (grep the FR id; never open the whole file). Build only what `build` lists and reply with `reply_format` from _standards.json.
build: /supervision coordinator view: teams without an accepted supervisor (status chips), 'Find match' sheet showing the top 3 with score bars (overlap, capacity) and an At capacity badge when curr >= max, assign dialog; override dialog requires a written reason. Supervisor workload table (curr / max, StatusBadge).
Supervisor view: pending requests with countdown to window_expires_at, accept and decline (reason) dialogs, 'My teams' list with team status and links to /chapters and /proposals.

Student view: 'My supervisor' card with name and assignment status; contact details inside a LockedCard until the grant exists, then office, hours and phone read from supervisor_contacts/{id} (client read is allowed only with the grant).
Skeletons, empty states, and error states throughout.
acceptance: Student sees the locked card before acceptance + approved topic and contact details after
Coordinator can assign and override from the UI
